name: RGB MoCap (toyxyz, video-to-3D motion capture for Windows)
summary: Native Windows app that turns ordinary video into editable 3D human animation using local AI solvers (FlowHMR, ExMR, GVHMR; optional PromptHMR, MAMMA multi-view). Mark foot/palm contacts on a timeline to fix sliding, retarget to Mixamo, VRM or PMX characters, and export FBX or VMD (MMD). Runs on an NVIDIA GPU.

access.license: MIT (app code); third-party solvers and weights under their own terms
access.notes: GVHMR/ExMR/PromptHMR/MAMMA are research/non-commercial; Ultralytics YOLO and HTD-Refine are AGPL-3.0; SMPL/SMPL-X body models need registration. FlowHMR code Apache-2.0 but uses SAM 3D Body/DINOv3 assets.

procedure: Install Git for Windows and clone https://github.com/toyxyz/toyxyz_RGBMocap
Run install.cmd (prepares ExMR, FlowHMR, GVHMR support)
Fetch model files in Model Manager; some need provider registration
Launch RGBMoCap.cmd, load a video, fix contacts, export FBX/VMD

verdict.why: Very strong traction (~936 stars in 2 weeks) and widely used in JP/CN creator circles. App code MIT, license notices read, but the default solvers are non-commercial and several deps are AGPL; held for a PM call on mixed-license mocap tools.
